findings.evidence: The 머물다 nuance says it is a "ㄹ-stem" whose "어-form irregularly doubles to 머물러요 / 머물렀어요". The standard analysis is that 머물다 is the shortened form of 머무르다 and cannot itself take a vowel-initial ending; 머물러 and 머물렀어요 come from the full form 머무르다 by 르-irregular conjugation, not by doubling the ㄹ-stem 머물-.
findings.fix: Added a corrected local 머물다 nuance to chapter-31 data, made local chapter nuance take precedence over parent enrichment, and confirmed the recompiled reveal explains 머물다 as the shortened form of 머무르다.
